
```{r load data, include=FALSE}

# Load the data
virus_counts <- read.table("data/virus_reads.txt", header = FALSE)
virus_counts <- virus_counts[1:23,]
colnames(virus_counts) <- c("sample", "count")

# split sample name into sample and timepoint
virus_counts <- virus_counts %>%
  separate(sample, c("timepoint", "sample", "replicate"), sep = "_")

virus_counts[19:23, 2:3] <- virus_counts[19:23, 1:2]
virus_counts[19:23, 1] <- "24"

# make new dataframe with mean readcounts per sample and stdev
virus_counts_mean <- virus_counts %>%
  group_by(sample, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(count), stdev = sd(count))

```



```{r barchart of virus reads, echo=FALSE}

ggplot(virus_counts, aes(x = paste(sample, timepoint), y = count, fill = replicate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", size = 0.5, position = "dodge") +

  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black"),

        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),

        panel.border = element_blank()) +

ggsave("data/plots/virus_readcounts.svg", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


```{r load covdata, echo=FALSE}

# Load virus fasta

# load coverage data
# Define a list to store the data frames
data_list <- list()

# Define a vector of sample names and timepoints
sample_names <- c("A2", "B3")
timepoints <- c("24", "48", "72")
replicates <- c("1", "2", "3")

# Loop through sample names, timepoints, and replicates to read the data
for (sample in sample_names) {
  for (timepoint in timepoints) {
    for (replicate in replicates) {
      # Construct the file path
      file_path <- paste("data/cov/coverage_", timepoint, "_", sample, "_", replicate, "_1.txt", sep="")
      
      # Read the data and store in the list
      data_list[[paste("coverage", sample, timepoint, replicate, sep="_")]] <- read.table(file_path, header = FALSE)
    }
  }
}

for (sample_name in names(data_list)) { 
  if (grepl("^coverage_A2_", sample_name)) {
    # Filter for V1 == "EVD68_A2"
    data_list[[sample_name]] <- data_list[[sample_name]][data_list[[sample_name]][,1] == "EVD68_A2",]
  } else if (grepl("^coverage_B3_", sample_name)) {
    # Filter for V1 == "EVD68_B3"
    data_list[[sample_name]] <- data_list[[sample_name]][data_list[[sample_name]][,1] == "EVD68_B3",]
  }
}

# harvest total readcounts
total_readcounts <- virus_counts[1:18,]
rownames(total_readcounts) <- paste(names(data_list)[c(1:3, 10:12, 4:6, 13:15, 7:9, 16:18)])
total_readcounts[, 3] <- as.numeric(total_readcounts[, 3])



# normalize coverage data
for (sample_name in names(data_list)) {
  data_list[[sample_name]][,3] <- data_list[[sample_name]][,3] / total_readcounts[rownames(total_readcounts) == sample_name, 4]}

# put all data in one dataframe
cov_data <- do.call(rbind, data_list)

cov_data$sample <- rownames(cov_data)

cov_data <- cov_data %>% separate(sample, c("cov", "sample", "timepoint", "replicate"), sep = "_")
# in $replicate, trash everything after and including "."
cov_data$replicate <- gsub("\\..*", "", cov_data$replicate)
# Rename columns
colnames(cov_data) <- c("Virus", "Position", "Coverage", "cov", "sample", "timepoint", "replicate")

# Reorder columns
cov_data <- cov_data[, c("Virus", "Position", "Coverage", "sample", "timepoint", "replicate")]


```

```{r plot coverage, echo=FALSE}

# Combine sample and timepoint into a new variable
cov_data$sample_time <- factor(paste(cov_data$sample, cov_data$timepoint, sep = "-"),
                                levels = c("A2-24", "B3-24", "A2-48", "B3-48", "A2-72", "B3-72"))

# Plot the coverage data
p <- ggplot(data = cov_data, aes(x = Position, y = Coverage)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = replicate), position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ sample_time, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(sample_time = label_parsed), scales = "fixed") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        panel.background = element_blank()) + 
  labs(title = "Virus coverage per sample", x = "Position", y = "Normalized coverage")

# Print the plot
print(p)



ggsave("data/plots/virus_coverage.svg", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```


```{r load mutation files, echo=FALSE}

# Load mutations from pysamstats
mut_list <- list()

# Define a vector of sample names and timepoints
sample_names <- c("A2", "B3")
timepoints <- c("24", "48", "72")
replicates <- c("1", "2", "3")

# Loop through sample names, timepoints, and replicates to read the data
for (sample in sample_names) {
  for (timepoint in timepoints) {
    for (replicate in replicates) {
      # Construct the file path
      file_path <- paste("data/mutations/", timepoint, "_", sample, "_", replicate, "_1.mutations.out", sep="")
      
      # Read the data and store in the list
      mut_list[[paste("mutations", sample, timepoint, replicate, sep="_")]] <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE)
    }
  }
}

for (sample_name in names(mut_list)) { 
  if (grepl("^A2_", sample_name)) {
    # Filter for V1 == "EVD68_A2"
    data_list[[sample_name]] <- data_list[[sample_name]][mut_list[[sample_name]][,1] == "EVD68_A2",]
  } else if (grepl("^B3_", sample_name)) {
    # Filter for V1 == "EVD68_B3"
    data_list[[sample_name]] <- data_list[[sample_name]][mut_list[[sample_name]][,1] == "EVD68_B3",]
  }
}

# normalize mutation data
for (sample_name in names(mut_list)) {
  mut_list[[sample_name]]$normalized_mutations <- (mut_list[[sample_name]][,8] + mut_list[[sample_name]][,10] + mut_list[[sample_name]][,12]) / mut_list[[sample_name]][,4]
}




```



```{r plot mutations, echo=FALSE}

# combine counts and mutations into one dataframe
mut_data <- do.call(rbind, mut_list)
mut_data$sample <- rownames(mut_data)

mut_data <- mut_data %>% separate(sample, c("mut", "sample", "timepoint", "replicate"), sep = "_")
mut_data$replicate <- gsub("\\..*", "", mut_data$replicate)



# Combine sample and timepoint into a new variable
mut_data$sample_time <- factor(paste(mut_data$sample, mut_data$timepoint, sep = "-"),
                                levels = c("A2-24", "B3-24", "A2-48", "B3-48", "A2-72", "B3-72"))

# Plot the coverage data
mut <- ggplot(data = mut_data, aes(x = pos, y = normalized_mutations)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = replicate), position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ sample_time, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(sample_time = label_parsed), scales = "fixed") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        panel.background = element_blank()) + 
  labs(title = "Virus mutations per sample", x = "Position", y = "Fraction of mutations to coverage")

# Print the plot
print(mut)



ggsave("data/plots/virus_mutations.svg", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```

```{r combined plot, echo=FALSE}

# replcae in total readcounts in the rownames "coverage" for "mutations"
rownames(total_readcounts) <- gsub("coverage", "mutations", rownames(total_readcounts))
# normalize mutation data by readcount
for (sample_name in names(mut_list)) {
  mut_list[[sample_name]]$rc_normalized_mutations <- mut_list[[sample_name]]$normalized_mutations / total_readcounts[rownames(total_readcounts) == sample_name, 4]
}

# combine counts and mutations into one dataframe
mut_data <- do.call(rbind, mut_list)
mut_data$sample <- rownames(mut_data)

mut_data <- mut_data %>% separate(sample, c("mut", "sample", "timepoint", "replicate"), sep = "_")
mut_data$replicate <- gsub("\\..*", "", mut_data$replicate)



# Combine sample and timepoint into a new variable
mut_data$sample_time <- factor(paste(mut_data$sample, mut_data$timepoint, sep = "-"),
                                levels = c("A2-24", "B3-24", "A2-48", "B3-48", "A2-72", "B3-72"))

# change colname pos to Position
colnames(mut_data)[2] <- "Position"
# Combine coverage and mutation data
combined_data <- merge(cov_data, mut_data, by = c("sample", "timepoint", "replicate", "Position"))

# make a combined plot
p <- ggplot(data = combined_data, aes(x = Position, y = Coverage)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = replicate), position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = rc_normalized_mutations, color = replicate), position = "identity", alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ sample_time.y, ncol = 2, 
             labeller = labeller(sample_time.y = label_parsed), scales = "fixed") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        panel.background = element_blank()) + 
  labs(title = "Virus coverage and mutations per sample", x = "Position", y = "Coverage")

p
ggsave("data/plots/combined_plot.svg", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
